confirmed_group_patterns.interpretation: Recurring foundations exist, but different series use different fonts; project README font lists are broader project requirements, not proof all are used for dialogue.

evidence: Sarazanmai preview scripts repeatedly use Source Han Sans SC/TC Medium and Source Han Serif SC/TC SemiBold
Koori no Jouheki EP16 uses Dream Han Sans SC/J W20 and Dream Han Serif SC/J W14

evidence: Endro EP01 and subsequent episodes repeat FZLanTingHei-DB-GBK for Default/Annotation/Staff; Screen uses Arial; Title uses FZShaoEr-M11 and FZ PangWa

evidence: Bocchi the Rock EP01-03 use FZKaTong-M19 for ED-CN, Aunt-香堇体 for ED-JP and FZMiaoWu for OP Title
confirmed_group_patterns.interpretation: Verified cross-episode recurrence is primarily OP/ED/title styles in the examined evidence; do not present as the dialogue default.

evidence: Nekopara Today's Neko08 notes production by 千夏; Default/Upper use 华康圆体W7-A, OP/ED JP use DFPMaruMoji-W7, OP/ED CN/title use 华康方圆体W7(P)

evidence: Kakegurui SP01 explicitly credits UHA-WINGS; dialogue style is 方正楷体_GBK; menu style uses 华康少女文字W5
confirmed_group_patterns.interpretation: The dialogue style and a menu-only decorative font must be recorded separately.

evidence: Revue Starlight film ASS uses 思源黑体 Bold in dialogue/annotation styles, Source Han Serif Bold for JP lyrics, 思源宋体 Bold for CN lyrics/title, FZSongHei for end notes
confirmed_group_patterns.interpretation: One film sample is not enough to declare a permanent group-wide default.

mixed_or_uncertain_attribution.note: The release filename is collaborative; styles include 方正小标宋_GBK, 方正书宋_GBK, HGMaruGothicMPRO and zhunyuan alias. The exact subtitle author was not independently confirmed.
The ASS filename suffix is .DHR; the reviewed excerpt did not establish a production credit. Treat fonts as sample evidence only, not definitive DHR style policy.
ASS Original Script says 漫游字幕组 and path suffix is UHA-WINGS. Fonts are attributable to this mixed source/post-production file, not safely to one group alone.
The release tag is a publisher/encoder tag in these examples. Read internal ASS production credits before assigning styles to a subtitle team.
